title: Rajas Con Crema
description: A creamy and spicy Mexican dish featuring roasted poblano peppers, onions, and garlic. Serve as a side or add to your favorite tacos or grilled meats.

ingredients.name: Poblano peppers
ingredients.notes: Roast over an open flame or in the oven until charred.

instructions: Place poblano peppers on a baking sheet and roast for 15-20 minutes, or until charred.
Remove peppers from oven and let cool. Peel off skin, remove seeds, and chop into strips.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until translucent.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add chopped poblano peppers and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Stir in shredded Manchego cheese until melted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, topped with a dollop of Mexican sour cream (Con crema).
